title: Historical migration depends on a live model method
reasoning: Migration 0011 imports hub.models and serializes hub.models.Church.get_default_pk as the field default. Historical migrations need to remain runnable from an empty database for future installs and CI. If Church.get_default_pk is renamed, removed, or starts depending on current model state, a fresh migration run can fail even though the migration file itself has not changed.
recommendation: Avoid importing live application models from migrations. Move the default/backfill logic into a RunPython function that uses apps.get_model, or keep a stable migration-local helper for the historical behavior and remove the model-method default after backfilling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No fresh-database migration test is included, and normal model tests would not catch a future break caused by changing the live Church model method.
suggestedRegressionTest: Run the full migration chain from an empty database in CI and assert that 0011 succeeds without importing current hub.models behavior.
minimumFixScope: Refactor 0011 so the migration does not reference hub.models.Church.get_default_pk directly.
